# gravitino_fileset Resource



## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_fileset" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The fileset name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment or description for the fileset.
- `properties` (Map of String) A map of key-value properties for the fileset.
- `storage_location` (String) The storage location for the fileset.
- `type` (String) The fileset type. Must be one of: managed, external.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the fileset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.catalog.schema.fileset'.
